anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck issues.
Trading metrics show no activity (totalPL, activeTrades, closedTrades, winRate, roi), which is unusual for an active trading platform.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, indicating a possible malfunction or misconfiguration.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load average and improve system performance.
Review and enhance AI algorithms to ensure they are functioning correctly and generating trading opportunities.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve any bottlenecks or inefficiencies.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting the platform's reliability.

recommendations.action: Examine the trading system configuration and logs to understand why there is no trading activity and rectify any issues.
recommendations.rationale: A lack of trading activity could indicate a system issue or misconfiguration, affecting revenue generation.

recommendations.action: Review AI system settings and logs to diagnose why it is not generating learning cycles or opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: Ensuring the AI system is operational is crucial for maintaining competitive trading strategies and platform efficiency.
